city_governor.require_happy: optional strict boolean; true is advertised only for an authoritatively disordered city

player_rates.bounds: tax, science, and luxury each remain in 0..60 and sum to 100
player_rates.treasury: advertise one exact science-to-tax recovery step and a bounded return toward 40/60
player_rates.disorder: advertise exact one-step transfers into luxury from tax or science and exact one-step restoration targets

policy_boundary.proxy: projects bounded exact city-governor and rate transitions without inferring whether food, happiness, treasury, research, or disorder should dominate
policy_boundary.planner: keeps both global luxury recovery and city-local require_happy selection disabled in live profiles; each remains an explicit diagnostic ablation after 480-turn evidence showed research starvation or accepted-without-effect server infeasibility

fail_closed: malformed governor booleans, out-of-bound food floors, and malformed or non-total rate targets are rejected
rate controls are absent in Anarchy or while stable-government selection is required
normalization, sanitization, validation, exact legal membership, and packet conversion preserve all three rates
invariants: city disorder can advertise an exact city-local happiness action without asserting that the server can satisfy it
no disorder recovery action is selected by the default live policy
treasury recovery never sacrifices tax to luxury while the exact reserve is unsafe
luxury restoration cannot oscillate below the last authoritatively insufficient rate for an unchanged city, population, and garrison signature
all rate effects remain subject to authoritative post-action verification
